analysis.topic: Federal Reserve forms FR 2028B and FR 2028S revision
analysis.summary: FR 2028B and FR 2028S forms restructured; many table columns removed; QTFL reference labels incorporated; OMB control number 7100-0061 retained; approval expiration updated to January 31, 2027.
analysis.impact: Form structure simplified; data entry fields reduced; reporting obligations unchanged.
analysis.affected_scope: Farm banks and lending institutions submitting FR 2028B and FR 2028S surveys.
analysis.actions: Update data submission processes to match condensed form layout; adopt new QTFL label references.
analysis.reason: Form revision to streamline agricultural lending survey reporting.

analysis.topic: CVA counterparty exposure and credit valuation adjustment reporting (Sub-schedules L.1.a, L.1.b.1, L.1.e, L.1.e.1, L.1.e.2, L.1.e.3, L.1.e.4, L.1.f.1, L.1.f.2)
analysis.summary: The Board of Governors restructured the layout of the CVA reporting form (Sub-schedule L.1), simplifying and reorganizing table headers across multiple sub-schedules including L.1.a, L.1.b.1, L.1.e, L.1.e.1, L.1.e.2, L.1.e.3, L.1.e.4, L.1.f.1, and L.1.f.2, consolidating and renaming columns while retaining the same underlying data fields.
analysis.impact: Institutions subject to Federal Reserve CCAR stress testing reporting requirements must adapt their data collection and submission processes to the new table structure, which may affect how counterparty identifiers, exposure metrics, and CVA figures are captured and reported.
analysis.affected_scope: Federal Reserve CCAR-reporting institutions submitting Sub-schedule L.1 CVA data via the revised form template
analysis.actions: Review updated form instructions and field definitions; update internal reporting templates and data dictionaries; train compliance and risk staff on new column layouts; validate submitted data against the new schema before each reporting cycle.
analysis.reason: Form restructuring to improve clarity, consistency, and usability of CVA exposure and counterparty data fields across sub-schedules.

analysis.topic: FR 2028D Small Business Lending Survey form layout revision
analysis.summary: The Federal Reserve's Small Business Lending Survey form FR 2028D has been updated with revised formatting, including simplified table structures and reorganized layout for reporting questions on small business loan volumes and terms.
analysis.impact: Institutions filing the FR 2028D survey will encounter a reformatted form layout; core reporting questions and data fields appear unchanged.
analysis.affected_scope: U.S. banks and financial institutions required to file the FR 2028D Small Business Lending Survey
analysis.actions: Review the updated form format and ensure reporting systems align with the revised layout for future quarterly submissions.
analysis.reason: The form layout was revised to simplify presentation and improve usability while maintaining existing reporting requirements.

analysis.summary: The reporting form has been amended to a truncated version, removing detailed schedules and sections, retaining only legal citation, burden estimate, and a brief table.
analysis.impact: Reduces reporting burden and limits detailed data collection; may affect regulatory oversight.
analysis.affected_scope: Bank holding companies and other entities required to file this report
analysis.actions: Update reporting forms to reflect amended content; adjust data collection accordingly.

analysis.topic: Schedule HC-R instructions for FR Y-9C
analysis.summary: The updated document removes a table and several paragraphs that detailed adjustments for CECL transitional amounts, AOCI opt-out, supplementary leverage ratio, and insurance underwriting company definitions.
analysis.impact: The removed content is no longer included in the instructions, which may simplify reporting for affected holding companies.
analysis.affected_scope: Holding companies that file FR Y-9C and use Schedule HC-R
